originalTitle: Fed's Logan calls for 'modestly higher' interest rates
simplifiedContent: The head of the Dallas Federal Reserve, Lorie Logan, thinks that interest rates should be a bit higher. This is because she believes that inflation, which is the rate at which prices are rising, is still too high. She's also worried about other factors, such as strong demand, investments in artificial intelligence, and tensions in the Middle East, that could make inflation worse. Logan's comments suggest that there might be disagreements within the Federal Reserve about what to do with interest rates, which will be decided at their next meeting in July. This matters because changes to interest rates can affect the overall economy and the stock market.

originalTitle: Dow Jones| Nasdaq | S&P 500 | US Stock Market Today | Live: US stocks slip as concerns over AI valuations weigh
simplifiedContent: The US stock market had a slow day today, with major indexes like the Dow Jones, Nasdaq, and S&P 500 going down. This happened because investors are worried that companies working with artificial intelligence (AI) might be overvalued, meaning their stock prices might be too high. As a result, investors are selling their stocks, causing the market to slip. This matters because it can affect the overall performance of the stock market and the value of individual investments. The decline in the market is a sign that investors are being cautious and reevaluating their investments in AI-related companies.

originalTitle: Netflix earnings in focus as shares gain slightly amid growth concerns
simplifiedContent: Netflix is about to release its financial results for the last quarter, and investors are watching closely. They think Netflix will say it made around $13 billion in revenue, which is 14% more than it made during the same time last year. Investors also expect Netflix to say it made 79 cents per share in profit, which is a 10% increase from last year. This matters because it will show if Netflix is still growing and making money, or if it's slowing down. If the results are good, it could help Netflix's stock price go up, but if they're bad, it could go down.

originalTitle: Gold, silver prices today: Comex gold and silver extend losses as Middle East tensions fuel rate hike fears
simplifiedContent: Here's what's happening: the prices of gold and silver have gone down again. This is because there's more tension between countries in the Middle East, which is making people think that the US will raise interest rates. When interest rates go up, it can make gold and silver less attractive to investors, which is why their prices are falling. Gold and silver prices have dropped to $3,977 and $55.65, respectively. This matters because it affects the value of investments in these precious metals.

originalTitle: Caliber Mining IPO raises  ₹135 crore from anchor investors ahead of issue opening
simplifiedContent: Caliber Mining and Logistics Limited is a company that is going to sell its shares to the public for the first time, which is called an Initial Public Offering (IPO). Before the IPO opens on July 17, 2026, the company has already raised ₹134.99 crore from a group of important investors, known as anchor investors. These investors bought 31,83,961 shares at a price of ₹424 each. This is significant because it shows that these big investors are interested in the company, which can be a positive sign for other investors. The company's ability to raise this amount of money from anchor investors may indicate a strong start to its IPO.
